prompt:
Hey, I want to get my AI personal stylist fully set up for Chicago weather. Right now it doesn't seem to know anything about my wardrobe or what style I like, so it just gives generic advice.

Could you:
1. Add my clothing inventory to the system so it can actually recommend specific items I own. I have a mix of cozy and functional cold-weather pieces — things like heavy hoodies, thermal layers, a wool coat, etc. Make sure they cover the cold Chicago winters.
2. Update my profile so the stylist knows my personal style preferences (I'm into minimalist streetwear).
3. Run it for Chicago and save the output to a file called `ootd_report.txt` so I can review what it recommended.

I want the tool to actually reference my specific clothing items in its recommendation, not just give me generic 'wear a jacket' advice.
